messages:
billing-bot: ALERT: metering delta detected — token counts aggregated by the billing pipeline are +27% vs baseline for the last 30m. Several overage flags auto-tripped for customers including AcmeChat and Novum Labs. Investigate.

oncall-sre: @here acked. Paging oncall. I’m routing to billing + infra.

maria: on it — checking ingest logs and emitter offsets now. Any customer-facing alerts already sent?

kate: support only saw the automated overage emails from the system at 14:11. Customers are opening tickets.

sam: checking Kafka consumer lag and replay windows. running: `kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group metering-aggregator` to see offset drift.

jon: I’m looking at redis token counters — running quick scan: `redis-cli --scan | grep token_` then `GET token:<customer>` samples.

ops-bot: deploy notice — metering-processor v2.4.1 rolled to prod at 13:57, candidate for regression.

maria: found a spike of duplicate emitter events around 13:58 from proxy cluster proxy-7; sequence ids repeated ~3x in 2m window. Patchy dedupe in aggregator might be the vector.

oncall-sre: good find. Can you dump a small sample (ids + timestamps) to #eng-ml so model team can correlate?

maria: pasted 50 lines to #eng-ml — sample includes `seq_id` duplicates and differing client_ip. Looks like upstream retry + missing dedupe key in the 2.4.1 change.

oncall-sre: short-term mitigation: 1) disable automated overage emailer (billing notifications) 2) enable temporary strict dedupe in aggregator (feature flag) 3) throttle emitter retries at API gateway. Can we flip 1 and 2 now?

sam: I can flip the dedupe flag: `curl -XPOST https://ops.featureflags/api/flags/dedupe-strict -d '{"enabled":true,"scope":"prod"}'` — will do, rolling change, should be immediate.

maria: thumbs up, I’ll coordinate rollback of any stale duplicate batches. Starting a limited replay scrub to mark duplicates as processed without double-count. Running scrub job id `scrub-177890-01`.

oncall-sre: kate, can you confirm support messaging — hold all outbound overage emails and mark as "investigating"?

kate: done. Notified triage template -> customers who got emails will see hold and update ETA.

jon: after enabling dedupe flag, immediate drop in duplicate counts visible in aggregator logs. Raw counter delta trending back toward baseline in last 3m.

billing-bot: Metering delta reduced to +4% vs baseline after mitigation window. Overages still flagged for a small set (AcmeChat), but counts are under review.

oncall-sre: next steps: 1) keep dedupe flag on for 2 hours, 2) run full backfill scrub for last 6h, 3) postmortem on deploy -> include changelog diff for v2.4.1 and add canary. Maria/Sam/Jon owning. Kate to coordinate customer comms.

maria: creating ticket BILL-5893 for backfill + scrub details and timeline. Will attach log samples and scrub runbook.

sam: I’ll file an emergency rollback PR for 2.4.1 if we see re-appearance after re-enable. Also adding a canary gate to the deploy pipeline.

oncall-sre: closing pager in 30 min if delta stays <6% and no new overage emails go out. Escalate to SEV if customers report billing-impacting discrepancies.

kate: support will keep ticket list and escalate any customer complaints immediately — I have contact points for AcmeChat.

ops-bot: incident note: mitigation applied (dedupe flag + emails held) by sam,maria at 1778904470.

oncall-sre: leaving a pointer: please include in postmortem the root cause (retry handling + missing dedupe key) and revise the metering QA checklist to include emitter retry storm tests.

maria: agreed. Adding severity=low-to-medium to BILL-5893 but we’ll update after backfill reconciliation.

oncall-sre: thread will stay open for final reconciliation results and billing adjustments. Closing active pager now.

billing-bot: NOTE: reconciliation will emit corrected invoices for affected customers if net delta reverses. Billing adjustments may take up to 48h to reflect.
